_comment: Feed list for Daily Rush Report. column: 1=Nation & Politics, 2=Money & World, 3=Culture, laugh=satire box (DISABLED Oct 31 2026 at Randall's request: all laugh feeds have enabled=false and build.py no longer shows satire; always labeled SATIRE; rotates across outlets: newest story from each satire outlet, at most 1 per outlet, outlet order reshuffled every hour, laugh_count shown; laugh_skip_words drops crude headlines). lead=true means stories from this feed may become the lead. max_age_hours drops stale items. per_column_culture: regular stories in the Culture column (default per_column). show_satire=false hides all satire everywhere. Set enabled=false to switch a feed off without deleting it. lead_hold_hours: how long an auto-picked lead stays up before rotating; avoid_repeat_leads: how many past leads are barred from returning. breaking_*: rules for red (breaking) headlines (see README). breaking_skip_sources: opinion/analysis outlets that never turn red and don't count as coverage. outlet_groups: web domain -> parent company, so sister outlets count as one outlet for red. opinion=true marks an opinion-only feed: its stories never turn red automatically (see README). Photos: column_photos = how many photos go in the columns (0 = none); photo_min_width / lead_photo_min_width skip small images; photo_search_depth = how far down each column to look for a story with a photo; photo_timeout_seconds = page/image fetch timeout. lifestyle_sections: small labeled lists under the Culture column (health, faith); a feed joins one with "lifestyle": "health"; these stories never lead, never turn red and don't count as coverage; max = stories shown, max_per_source = per outlet. Per-feed options: max_per_column (tighter per-source cap), skip_if_url_contains, skip_if_title_starts_with, skip_if_title_matches (regex; drop matching headlines), skip_categories, title_must_match (regex), strip_title_suffix, user_agent, accept, fallback_url / fallback_allowed_sources (used if the primary feed fails), guarantee_slot (lifestyle: reserve a section slot when this feed has a fresh story). Section options: guarantee (list of feed names with a reserved slot), skip_if_title_matches.
